title: outbox_worker -> \! with irrefutable let Err pattern is correct and should be kept
description: outbox_worker returning -> \! and using 'let Err(e) = h.await' in the supervision loop is the correct design. The never type makes the 'Ok case is unreachable' invariant machine-checkable rather than a comment. A future contributor might suggest adding a return type or wrapping in match to handle Ok — that would re-introduce dead code. This pattern should be defended: the compiler is the oracle, not the programmer.
